programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Gumball and Darwin agree to do all of Tobias's chores in exchange for good points! Gumball and Darwin discover that Tobias is doing way better than them in an online game called Galatrek. Tobias admits he earns "good points" doing chores for his parents which he then exchanges for dollars to buy cool stuff for Galatrek. If Gumball and Darwin do Tobias' chores they can earn his "good points" and use them for Galatrek. Gumball and Darwin think they've hit the jackpot. But these "good points" may not be quite as good as Tobias claims...

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons try and reconnect Darwin to his fish roots. When Mom sees Darwin gazing longingly at a fish-tank she thinks their mammalian lifestyle isn't fulfilling her adopted son and deep down he longs to connect with his fishy roots. So the family try to re-connect him with his aquatic culture; they try fish-food fish-language even fish clothes. But when none of it works they realize they may have to let him go.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Fun Dungeon Face Off: Clarence's Mom treats Clarence, Jeff and Sumo to an afternoon at Rough Riders Chicken, a fast food restaurant with a play emporium. When Clarence and Sumo steal Jeff's fries, Jeff is forced to confront his germ phobias head-on in the restaurant's seemingly unsanitary play area. / Pretty Great Day with a Girl: Clarence and Amy, a unique girl from down the street, bond over a hunt for a monstersized rock called an "erratic."

programme.title: Clarence
programme.desc: Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. The Stump Kids head over to the Elder Rock to ask the Elders something, only to discover that they have been trapped underneath their rock for five days after their support gave way. Not wanting their parents to come, Craig and Kelsey try to free them while JP fills in at Mark's job - meanwhile, the Elders livestream their struggle as Creek Kids from all over watch on.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Animated comedy following the adventures of Craig and his two friends Kelsey and JP. To prove Kelsey's 'worthitude', Craig and JP put her through a series of hero trials to reclaim her sword, but she soon learns that this is not enough to sway her father.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

programme.title: Lana Longbeard
programme.desc: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father's adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

programme.title: Adventure Time
programme.desc: Adventure Time is an American fantasy animated television series that shows a 12-year-old boy Finn and his best friend, a wise 28-year-old (in dog years) dog Jake with magical powers living in Lands of Ooo in post-apocalyptic world. They lean on each other during good and bad times, trust each another with secrets and look to each other for advice. Finn likes to travel and save princesses from evil monsters in Lands of Ooo. Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

Jake is more than his friend, he is his mentor, and his extraordinary skills help the boy to fight evil. Finn and Jake hang out with Princess Bubblegum, the sovereign of the Candy Kingdom, the fearsome Ice King, an ice wizard, Marceline the Vampire Queen, a 1000-year-old vampire and rock musician and many more.

programme.title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball‌
programme.desc: In Elmore, reality bends and family life gets weird. Gumball pulls Darwin, Anais, and the whole town into adventures - from fighting evil fast food to dealing with an AI crushing on his mom. The show's so wild, it needed a new name.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: Mount Kailash - The Journey Within
programme.desc: This seven-part docu-series takes the viewer on an incredible journey of discovery to the legendary Mount Kailash, the home of Lord Shiva and his consort Parvati. Beginning in Delhi, the team travel for a month, hiking through the forbidding terrain of Uttarakhand and on into the volatile climes of Tibet on their sacred adventure. Spectacular natural scenery provides a spiritual backdrop to this profound physical, emotional, and soulful experience, testing both the mind and body. Have the most profound experience of a lifetime and follow the fearless team every step of their way.

Experience a true paradise where the azul waves wash your feet. Relax just by listening to the waves whisper, uncover tropical beaches with endless sunshine and watch thousands of colorful fishes swimming around you in the salty sea water.

programme.title: Major League Baseball. Red Sox - Orioles
Football: French Ligue 1
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.title: Football: Bundesliga
programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. This programme brings all the games of the german top-flight into one place, so that you can easily catch up with the week's action. As we reach the business end-of-the-season, watch the victors and losers dictate the final table. With relegation spots and Champions League places yet to be decided, it promises to be a rather exciting conclusion for all those concerned.

programme.desc: Õhkkond "Sinises koeras" on pingetest paks. Diana teab, millistele nuppudele vajutada, et oma töötajaid ja armukesi panna tegema asju, mida mitte keegi tavaolukorras ei teeks. Kui tapetakse järjekordne agentuuri "Sinine koer" töötaja, siis selgub, et Diana oli temaga vahetult enne surma seksuaalvahekorras.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Kristina on läbielamiste tõttu täiesti apaatseks muutunud ja ennast käest lasknud. Tüdrukud üritavad talle kõikvõimalike trikkidega eluvaimu sisse puhuda, aga asjata. Miša ja Maria päästavad ühe poisi kiusajate küüsist ja parandavad loodetavasti oma karmat. Samal ajal muutub aga Laural kodus olukord täiesti talumatuks, kui Ken-Robin ja kuri ämm teda igast nurgast ründavad ja Chris peab samas kohe välismaale ärireisile sõitma. Kas Laural läheb nüüd juhe lõplikult kokku?

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika saavad Kulbi tänava inimsööjaloo peamise kahtlusaluse jälile, aga Reinu endine partner Urmas laseb kahtlusalusel käest lipsata. Relika ema läheb viimaks tagasi Kiviõlisse ja Relika tahab nüüd jälle täiel rinnal oma elu elama hakata - ta läheb koos korrapidaja Õiega ööklubisse. Rein saab aga ülemusega ootamatult hästi läbi ja mehed teevad peale tööd linnas väiksed napsud. Hans-Kristjan vaevleb kahtluste käes, mille intrigaanist Urmas tema hinge on istutanud. Rein on hädas, sest naine ajas talle viis tolmuimejatellimust välja ja mees mässib ennast nüüd üha sügavamale hädavaledesse, et naise eest varjata, et ta töötab ikka veel politseis, ega müü tolmuimejaid. Rein saab viimaks olulise vihje, et koos Relikaga ise Kulbi tänava inimsööjaloo peamine kahtlusalune arreteerida.

programme.title: Padjaklubi
programme.desc: Laura ei saa oma ülipeene ja pirtsaka ämmaga läbi ja tüdrukud tulevad talle appi, et koos ämm majast välja süüa. Algab pöörane ja naljakas operatsioon, mis nii ämma kui sõbrannade närvid kõvasti proovile paneb. Lõpuks tuleb aga lahendus hoopis ootamatu nõksu abil, Ken-Robin peab minema fitnessivõsitlustele, aga satub sõna otseses mõttes hullumeelsesse sekeldusse. Osa lõpeb aga Laurale tõelise pommuudisega!

programme.title: Kullakesed
programme.desc: Dorothy, Blanche, Rose ja Sophia on neli eakat vanadaami. Nende kõigi suurimaks ühiseks jooneks on nende abikaasad - kõik on kas surnud või lahutand. Neli vanamemme otsustavad kokku kolida, et vanaduspõlve hõlpsamaks ning huvitavamaks teha.Kuid samas pole mitte ühelgi neist kadunud ammune janu meeste järgi. Igaüks üritab endale pidevalt kaaslast leida ning vahest ka teiselt üle trumbata.

programme.title: Ment
programme.desc: Rein ja Relika vahistavad Kulbi tänava juhtumi peamise kahtlusaluse ja Rein saab võimaluse kurikael ise üle kuulata. Salakaval Urmas on raevus, sest Rein kogub ülemuse silmis plusspunkte. Urmas ei istu aga käed rüpes vaid korraldab Reinule lõksu ja Rein jääb oma naisele kõige ebasobilikumal hetkel sellega vahele, et ta ei müügi tolmuimejaid vaid töötab endiselt politseis. Reinu kodune elu on nüüd hoobilt veel hullemas seisus kui eales varem. Vahepeal kohtub aga Relika kena torumehega ja Staarkaebaja annab Reinule ootamatu vihje liputaja kohta. Tänu Reinu pingutustele ja oma koduse elu ohverdamisele on Kulbi tänava inimsööjaloo lahendus nüüd käeulatuses.

programme.title: Kättemaksukontor
programme.desc: Kui keskealine Oskar Pooland hakkab ootamatult sporti tegema, peaks selle üle ainult rõõmu tundma, kuid mitte Linda, tema naine. Naisele selgub ootamatult, et ta on Oskari spordile kaotanud, sest mees ei pööra talle enam üldse tähelepanu ja unistab ainult Ironmani võistlusest. Linda pöördub Kättemaksukontori poole.

programme.title: Skandaal
programme.desc: Endine USA Presidendi meediasuhete konsultant Olivia Pope on nüüd kriisijuht, kes suudab lahendada kõik probleemid nii, et keegi ei teagi, et sellised probleemid olemas olid. Kuid ükskõik kui hoolas sa oled oma töös, võid samal ajal enda eraelus väga palju kahju teha. Igal nädalal seisavad Olivia ja ta meeskond silmitsi paljude probleemidega, mis vajavad lahendamist. Ning kui nad suudavad päästa teiste inimeste elusid, ei tähenda see seda, et nad suudavad parandada ka enda omi.

programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond

programme.title: CSI: Vegas

programme.title: Hotell Costiera
programme.desc: Vana juudi naine sureb Villa Costieras viibides ning tema poeg Richard lendab New Yorgist ema surnukeha koju viima. Danieli ülesanne on korraldada võimalikult kiire transport, mis ei õnnestu aga takistusteta. Richard saab ema kohta teada jahmatava tõe.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. Endine eriagent Reese (Jim Caviezel), kes pärast isiklikku tragöödiat elab New Yorkis kodutuna, on nõus Fichiga kampa lööma ja aitab Finchil huvipakkuva isiku üles leida. Reese'i ülesandeks jääb ka tulevase tapja kahjutuks tegemine. Loomulikult peab tandem tegutsema ülima saladuskatte all, sest nende info ja tegevuse paljastamise tagajärjed oleksid katastroofilised.

programme.title: Kurjuse kannul
programme.desc: FBI kõige kogenumatest uurijatest ning profileerijatest koostatud meeskond lahendab ränki kuritegusid, mis esmapilgul tunduvad väljapääsmatult keerukad. Meeskonna iga liige on oma valdkonna tipp ning üksteist täendades pole ükski kuritegu neile lahendamatu.

programme.title: Chicago politseijaoskond
programme.desc: Luureüksus paljastab üllatava kahtlusaluste rühma pangaröövide seerias.

programme.title: Surmarelv
programme.desc: Legendaarsetel "Surmarelva" filmidel põhinev veriväske action-komöödiasari toob taas kokku kinoajaloo vingeima detektiivide paari! Oma naist leinav endine eriüksuslane Martin Riggs (Clayne Crawford) ja pärast infarkti tööle naasev Roger Murtaugh (Damon Wayans) moodustavad üdini vastandliku, aga ometi ideaalselt toimiva tandemi. Nende koostöö algus on okkaline, sest ohjeldamatu Riggsi pea-ees-tulle-sööstmise suhtumine põrkub vaoshoitud Murtaugh arusaamadega. Esimese ühise juhtumi lõppedes mõistavad aga mõlemad, et on lisaks uuele paarimehele leidnud endale ka parima sõbra.

programme.desc: Jõmpsikad mässivad end seiklusse, kus neid abistavad Thornberry'de pere liikmed. Nood reisivad ümber maailma ja filmivad dokumentaalfilme loodusest.

programme.title: Mõtle nagu mees
programme.desc: Neli sõpra avastavad, et nende abikaasad on kasutanud nende vastu Steve Harvey suhtenõuandeid. Nad lepivad kokku, et annavad naistele vastulöögi.

programme.title: Kiirperekond
programme.desc: Kiirperekond on moodne ja emotsionaalne komöödia, mis jutustab loo Elliest (Rose Byrne) ja Pete'ist (Mark Wahlberg), kes otsustavad saada kasuvanemateks. Teinud algust lapsendamisprotsessiga ja valides potentsiaalset kasvandikku, tekib neil endalegi üllatuseks hea side ühe iseteadliku 15-aastase tüdrukuga (Isabela Moner). Kuid siis selgub, et ninakal teismelisel on ka nunnu pisiõde ja väikevend ning enne veel kui Ellie ja Pete saavad aru oma valiku tagajärgedest, on nad lapsendanud kamba põngerjaid, kel pole mingit huvi saada hästi kasvatatud lasteks.

programme.title: Võidusõidusebra
programme.desc: Hüljatud sebra kasvab üles uskudes, et ta on võidusõiduhobune; koos aedikusõprade ja teismelise tüdruku abiga asub ta täitma oma unistust võistelda koos puhtavereliste hobustega.

programme.title: Farmi peoloomad
programme.desc: Kui farmer on ära, siis kõik loomad mängivad, laulavad ja tantsivad. Lõpuks peab aga keegi sekkuma ja juhtimise üle võtma ning vastutus jääb muretu lehma Otise kanda.

programme.title: Kindlasti... võib-olla
programme.desc: USA 2008 romantiline komöödia Lavastaja: Adam Brooks Osades: Ryan Reynolds, Isla Fisher, Abigail Breslin, Elizabeth Banks, Rachel Weisz ("Allikas") Will Hayes (Ryan Reynolds) on Manhattanil elav reklaamiproff, kel käsil abielulahutus. Mehe suureks üllatuseks hakkab ta 10-aastane tütar Maya (Abigail Breslin) esitama küsimusi ajast enne abiellumist, tahtes kuulda absoluutselt kõike sellest, kuidas ta vanemad kohtusid ja armusid. Mees muudab jutustuses osaliste nimed ning seetõttu on Mayal väga raske mõistatada, milline loo kolmest naisest on see, kellega ta isa viimaks abiellus. Kas on selleks koolipõlve armastus Emily (Elizabeth Banks), kauaaegne parim sõber April (Isla Fisher) või hoopis vabameelne ambitsioonikas ajakirjanik Summer (Rachel Weisz)? Isa lugu hoolega kuulav tüdruk saab aru, et armastus on sageli arusaamatu ja alati keeruline. Lugu tütrele jutustades saab Will omakorda aru, et kindlasti pole iial liiga hilja, et minna tagasi, sest võib-olla õnnestub vaid nii leida õnnelik lõpp.

programme.title: Õudne film
programme.desc: USA 2000 õuduskomöödia Lavastaja: Keenen Ivory Wayans Osades: Shannon Elizabeth, Regina Hall, Jon Abrahams, Marlon Wayans, Shawn Wayans, Carmen Electra jpt. Kogu loo lükkab käima kauni abituriendi mõrv, keda maskis tapja alguses telefonitsi terroriseeris. See sündmus ehmatab ära tapetu teismelised klassikaaslased (keda mängivad loomulikult näitlejad vanuses 20-30!), kes kannavad nimesid nagu Buffy, Brenda, Drew. Kangelanna Cindy Campbell (Anna Faris) peab koos sõpradega kaitsma end nii maskis tapja kui ka üliagara kriminaalreporteri eest. Kas tuleb tuttav ette? Sellegipoolest on tegijatel varuks veel nii mõnigi roppnaljakas üllatus, mille puhul tundub uskumatu, et keegi midagi sellist üldse julgeb kinoekraanil näidata. "Õudne film" on häbitu paroodia, mille tegijad irvitavad paljude kassatükkide üle, kusjuures oma osa saavad nii "Matrix", "Kuues meel", "Tavalised kahtlusalused", "Blairi nõiafilm", "Karje" jt.
